purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/registry evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: ANCFCC public sources describe cadastral maps and map products, but inspected catalog/service pages do not offer an anonymous full-polygon feature endpoint.
registryAssessment: ANCFCC lists a Cadastre office in Kenitra (Avenue Arryada, Eaux et Forêts, BP 400) and the official product catalogue lists Kenitra cadastral maps. This is specific local custodian evidence.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official ANCFCC external-office directory lists a Cadastre office in Kenitra at Avenue Arryada, Eaux et Forêts, BP 400.

ANCFCC catalogue lists Kenitra cadastral mapping products (four 1:10,000 sheets, dated 2016) and separate Kenitra East/West urban plans dated 2018. The catalogue documents map products, not an open parcel-vector service.
ANCFCC describes cadastral plans and technical cadastral documents, supporting the agency’s cadastral role.
